import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, c, f, rev;
        Edge(int to, int c, int f, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.c = c;
            this.f = f;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static final int N = 11;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int SIZE = 2 * N * N;

    static List<Edge>[] g = new ArrayList[SIZE];
    static int[] d = new int[SIZE];
    static int[] ptr = new int[SIZE];
    static int s, t, n, tbad;
    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static int[][][][] dst = new int[N][N][N][N];
    static char[][] a = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] b = new char[N][N];
    static int px, py;
    static Pair bad;
    static Queue<Pair> go = new LinkedList<>();
    static final int[] X = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] Y = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static class Pair {
        int f, s;
        Pair(int f, int s) {
            this.f = f;
            this.s = s;
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int v, int u, int cap) {
        g[v].add(new Edge(u, cap, 0, g[u].size()));
        g[u].add(new Edge(v, 0, 0, g[v].size() - 1));
    }

    static boolean buildLevNet() {
        Arrays.fill(d, INF);
        d[s] = 0;
        q.clear();
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : g[v]) {
                int to = e.to;
                int cf = e.c - e.f;
                if (d[to] == INF && cf > 0) {
                    d[to] = d[v] + 1;
                    q.add(to);
                }
            }
        }
        return d[t] != INF;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int curFlow) {
        if (v == t) return curFlow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ptr[v]++) {
            Edge e = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
            int to = e.to;
            int cf = e.c - e.f;
            if (d[to] == d[v] + 1 && cf > 0) {
                int addFlow = dfs(to, Math.min(curFlow, cf));
                if (addFlow > 0) {
                    e.f += addFlow;
                    g[to].get(e.rev).f -= addFlow;
                    return addFlow;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinica() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (buildLevNet()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int add;
            while ((add = dfs(s, INF)) > 0) {
                flow += add;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static boolean check(Pair v) {
        return v.f >= 0 && v.f < n && v.s >= 0 && v.s < n && a[v.f][v.s] != 'Y' && a[v.f][v.s] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfs(int xs, int ys) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                dst[xs][ys][i][j] = INF;
        dst[xs][ys][xs][ys] = 0;
        go.clear();
        go.add(new Pair(xs, ys));
        while (!go.isEmpty()) {
            Pair v = go.poll();
            if (dst[xs][ys][v.f][v.s] == dst[bad.f][bad.s][v.f][v.s] && (bad.f != xs || bad.s != ys))
                continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nf = v.f + X[i];
                int ns = v.s + Y[i];
                Pair nv = new Pair(nf, ns);
                if (check(nv) && dst[xs][ys][nv.f][nv.s] == INF && dst[xs][ys][v.f][v.s] + 1 <= dst[bad.f][bad.s][nv.f][nv.s]) {
                    dst[xs][ys][nv.f][nv.s] = dst[xs][ys][v.f][v.s] + 1;
                    go.add(nv);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        tbad = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < SIZE; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                a[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    px = i;
                    py = j;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                b[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        bad = new Pair(px, py);
        bfs(px, py);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                dst[bad.f][bad.s][i][j] = Math.min(dst[bad.f][bad.s][i][j], tbad);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (check(new Pair(i, j))) bfs(i, j);

        s = 0;
        t = 2 * n * n + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (a[i][j] != '0') {
                    addEdge(s, i * n + j + 1, a[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (b[i][j] != '0') {
                    addEdge(i * n + j + 1 + n * n, t, b[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; ++i1) {
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; ++j1) {
                        if (check(new Pair(i, j)) && check(new Pair(i1, j1)) && dst[i][j][i1][j1] <= dst[px][py][i1][j1]) {
                            addEdge(i * n + j + 1, i1 * n + j1 + 1 + n * n, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinica());
    }
}
